## Runway Gen-4.5 API

Runway Gen-4.5 is a text to video and image to video model by Runway, available on the Venice API as `runway-gen4-5-text`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Runway Gen-4.5's text-to-video variant generates 2- to 10-second clips from prompts of up to 1,000 characters, using Runway's Gen-4.5 video model.

### Runway Gen-4.5 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runway-gen4-5-text` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.162 / sec |
| `runway-gen4-5` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.162 / sec |

### Runway Gen-4.5 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Runway |
| Released | Apr 12, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | text to video and image to video |
| Durations | 2–10s, any whole second |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16 |
| Audio | None |

### How to use the Runway Gen-4.5 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "runway-gen4-5-text"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "runway-gen4-5-text",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "runway-gen4-5-text", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
